name: allowlister-e2e
//: The offline end-to-end suite: spawns the compiled allowlister binary against temp-dir config sandboxes. Its Cargo dev-dependency on allowlister (for a few library helpers its assertions reuse) is restated as the implicit dependency, since Nx does not read Cargo manifests; nothing depends on this project except the coverage aggregate.

test.//: After allowlister:build, so a broken binary fails there by name. Under coverage the journeys drive the instrumented copy tools/coverage/coverage.sh builds into target/llvm-cov-target, so the crate lines they reach count toward coverage:coverage.
